stories.title: Driver heads to custody after Shotton foot patrol turns up three offences

stories.summary: A school catering company set up by Flintshire County Council has donated £300 each to two Flintshire-based charities to mark Mental Health Awareness Week. stories.title: Lost a horse? Police in Flint Mountain are trying to find its owner
stories.summary: A horse has been found wandering on a road at Flint Mountain and North Wales Police are trying to track down its owner. The force’s North Flintshire neighbourhood policing team said they had received multiple calls from members of the public who had spotted the horse in the road. The animal has now been secured.

stories.title: Sandycroft: Plans for 26,000 sq ft Body Tech gym at Engineer Park submitted to Flintshire
stories.summary: A planning application has been submitted to turn two vacant industrial units in Sandycroft into what Body Tech Fitness has called the largest independent gym in Wales.
